subject: science
domain: Motion and Stability: Forces and Interactions

items.prompt:
The formula for momentum is
A) p = mv
B) p = m + v
C) p = ma
D) p = F/m

A 2 kg object moving at 3 m/s has a momentum of
A) 6 kg m/s
B) 5 kg m/s
C) 1.5 kg m/s
D) 9 kg m/s

Total momentum is conserved when there is
A) no net external force
B) a large external force
C) friction only
D) no motion ever

steps: No external force means momentum is conserved.

items.prompt:
Two carts have momenta 6 and 4 in the same direction. With no external force, the total after a collision is
A) 10 kg m/s
B) 2 kg m/s
C) 24 kg m/s
D) 0 kg m/s

A still cart has a momentum of
A) zero
B) its mass
C) its velocity
D) infinite

steps: A still object has zero momentum.

items.prompt:
A 3 kg cart moving at 4 m/s has a momentum of
A) 12 kg m/s
B) 7 kg m/s
C) 1 kg m/s
D) 0.75 kg m/s

A 3 kg cart at 4 m/s hits a still cart with no external force. The total system momentum after is
A) 12 kg m/s
B) 0 kg m/s
C) 6 kg m/s
D) 24 kg m/s

Conservation of momentum helps predict motion after a collision because
A) the total momentum after equals the total before
B) momentum disappears
C) momentum doubles
D) momentum is random
items.answer: A) the total momentum after equals the total before
